How It All Started

Why I fell in love with Sri Lanka?

I went to Sri Lanka for only 11 days. I came back with a piece of my heart left there. It wasn’t just the palm trees or the golden sunsets.

Sri Lanka isn’t just a destination. It’s a feeling you carry home with you. And that’s exactly why I created this space.

It was the feeling. The slow mornings. The sound of the ocean. The spiritual calm I felt walking through temples. It was a meditation.

It doesn’t try to impress you. Simply lets you breathe. Every day felt different, yet everything felt connected — nature and simplicity.
